graph_edits.rationale: Retain the dominant curved gesture but re-shape it into a more hall-like longitudinal sweep instead of a closed object loop.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent curved loop/arc mass across the four views, so it avoids fragmentation and has decent repair integrity. The green parcel is respected, but the form does not strongly respond to the east access edge with a legible public threshold; the void is internal and not clearly organized as a public entry/court condition. Most importantly, for a gymnasium the visible mass does not convincingly express one clear long-span hall with subordinate support and roof/daylight logic. Instead it reads as a compact sculptural ring with a carved center, which is closer to an abstract object than a hall typology. The stepped/cascading section is present but not yet doing programmatic work for span or daylight, so program fit fails the hard gate.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more open and pavilion-like; candidate is much more compact and looped, without the same clear long-span reading.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low horizontal hall datum with a clearly legible public edge and light roof articulation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Useful for roof and hall hierarchy, but candidate lacks the same clear linear hall body.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long-span sports volume with a strong sectional roof identity and a subordinate support/entry condition.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is court-centered and more openly occupied; candidate’s void is internal and less publicly legible.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Carved ground/court logic producing a public void under a larger mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is not a shape template for gymnasium massing and overstates vertical monumentality relative to the brief.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Tall sloped/monolithic civic object with a singular carved opening condition.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Visually closer to a museum/object building than a gymnasium; the sectional logic is not appropriate for the required clear-span hall.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Layered, boxy museum-like stacking with a strong urban object presence.

warnings: Program hard gate failed: the visible mass does not read as a believable gymnasium hall with subordinate support and section logic.
Access-edge response is weak: the verified frontage is not met with a clearly public void or entry seam.
The internal void is present but not sufficiently public-facing to count as a strong threshold.
Do not amplify the object-like loop without adding a hall-like section and clearer access articulation.
